market_summary: USD strength dominates FX during London/NY overlap, with EURUSD and GBPUSD printing high-conviction bearish expansion moves confirmed by negative CVD and high RVOL. XAUUSD exhibits extreme downward momentum but is stretched beyond ATR bands without fresh volume confirmation. US100 remains consolidated inside its session Value Area near Session Highs, while BTCUSD trades weak below VWAP without sufficient volume to confirm a breakdown.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4039.33) and POC (4044.58). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.21) with slight positive slope (+0.14). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. While high momentum is present, price is severely extended outside the lower ATR band with no RVOL yellow spike to confirm clean continuation, risking a mean-reversion trap. Prefer HOLD.

Dukascopy tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0, but current bar shows rejection off Session High (28310.45) back inside VA. Wait for clearer breakout or pull back to VWAP. Prefer HOLD.

Price is below VAL (73512.22) and POC (73660.40). CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) with negative slope (-0.02). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP.
